statement: Let n = len(nums). The function returns a result r (i.e., it does not fail) and r = true if and only if there exists an integer s with 0 <= s < n such that for every j with 0 <= j < n-1, nums[(s+j) mod n] <= nums[(s+j+1) mod n]. (This says nums is a rotation of a non-decreasing array.)
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.
